claim: For an IB graduate, only the IB Diploma is accepted as the Hungarian school-leaving certificate (érettségi bizonyítvány); Certificates and Course Results are not.
excerpt: Az IB rendszerében végzettek esetében érettségi bizonyítványként kizárólag az IB Diploma fogadható el, egyéb dokumentum (pl. Certificate/Course result) nem.
interpretation: The Diploma / Course Results line, stated by the body that runs Hungarian admissions. This page governs the central Hungarian-language procedure; the English-taught programmes most IB students apply to run their own admissions and entrance exams, so for them the institution's page is the one that decides.

notes: The page is the 2026 admission guide (FFT_2026A). The 2027 guide was not yet published; re-read when it is.

attestation.by: the Hungary, Slovenia and Poland floor pass
attestation.note: Read in Hungarian. The same page also accepts an authenticated Results Summary showing the Diploma awarded, and rejects provisional results.

claim: Hungary has 64 accredited higher education institutions of two types, egyetem (university) and főiskola (college), ranging from small universities of applied sciences to research universities, offering more than 700 courses in foreign languages.
excerpt: Higher education studies are offered at two types of higher education institutions, egyetem (university) and főiskola (college), both of them may offer courses in all three training cycles
interpretation: Descriptive only. The same page says the 64 range 'from minor universities of applied sciences to top research universities', so the English label a student meets for a főiskola is increasingly 'university of applied sciences'.

attestation.by: the Hungary, Slovenia and Poland floor pass

claim: Hungarian higher education includes a four-semester higher vocational programme (felsőoktatási szakképzés) that gives a vocational qualification but not a degree, with part of its credits recognised on later bachelor study; bachelor programmes take 6–8 semesters and some fields, such as medicine, are 10–12-semester undivided programmes.
excerpt: a 4 féléves szakképzések felsőfokú szakképzettséget adnak, de diplomát nem.
interpretation: This is the short-cycle route nobody mentions to foreigners. Whether any of it is offered in English was not established.

attestation.by: the Hungary, Slovenia and Poland floor pass

claim: Semmelweis takes applications for English-taught medicine through its own online system, SEMAPHOR, with an application deadline of 31 May 2027 and tuition of 9,340 EUR a semester; the school-leaving certificate must be uploaded by 21 August of the application year.
excerpt: Application deadline: 31 May, 2027 […] 9340 EUR / semester + one time fees […] School Leaving Certificate has to be uploaded into the University's online application system SEMAPHOR by the 21st of August the year of application.
interpretation: Two findings in one page. Applying is direct to the university, not through a national portal. And the July problem has an answer here: an IB candidate applies before results and uploads the Diploma after 6 July, with 21 August as the outer limit.

attestation.by: the Hungary, Slovenia and Poland floor pass
attestation.note: The application opening date is printed as '(to be announced soon)'.

claim: Pécs Medical School opens applications for 2027/28 on 1 November 2026 and closes them on 30 June 2027, admitting continuously so that earlier applicants face more open places.
excerpt: the application period starts on 1st November 2026 and the application deadline is 30th June 2027 for the academic year 2027/2028
interpretation: A second institution with a different date from Semmelweis's, which is the point: in Hungary each university sets its own. Continuous admission makes the published deadline the last possible day rather than a safe one.

attestation.by: the Hungary, Slovenia and Poland floor pass
